def: to be exercised by a dæmon
kjv: have a (be vexed with, be possessed with) devil(-s)

words.word: those which were possessed with devils
him that was possessed with the devil
to him that was possessed with the devil
he that had been possessed with the devil
he that was possessed of the devils
of him that hath a devil

occurrences.text: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
words: those which were possessed with devils

occurrences.text: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:
And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
words: him that was possessed with the devil

occurrences.text: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
words: to him that was possessed with the devil

occurrences.text: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.
words: he that had been possessed with the devil

occurrences.text: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.
words: he that was possessed of the devils

occurrences.text: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?
words: of him that hath a devil
